title: Natural versus organophilized smectites as drug adsorbents: experiment and molecular modeling
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36065-36083
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04769B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jonáš Tokarský, Pavlína Peikertová, Klára Výšková, Markéta Davidová, Silvie Vallová
Original smectites exhibit the same or higher adsorption efficiency of drugs (ampicillin and lamotrigine) from water compared to smectites organophilized with environmentally hazardous tetradecyltrimethylammonium cations.
